infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Moves uses Bluetooth, only while the app is open and only if you turn it on, to notice when you're with friends at a Move so it can mark you as there. It broadcasts a rotating code, never your name or location.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Moves uses your location to show what friends are doing near you and to suggest places. Your exact location never leaves your phone.

plugins.cameraPermission: Moves uses the camera so you can snap the Move you're at. Snapshots only go to people who can already see that Move.

plugins.microphonePermission: Moves listens for "start a Move" and "confirm" when you tap Talk, from your phone or your glasses. Audio is only used to understand that command.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Moves turns what you say into a draft Move. Nothing posts until you confirm.
